semiconductor_relevance: High — Ellipsiz DSS provides specialized distribution and service solutions for the semiconductor industry, focusing on equipment and support services.
summary: Ellipsiz DSS is a distribution and service solutions provider for the semiconductor market in the Asia Pacific region, offering a comprehensive portfolio of wafer fabrication process equipment and board level test equipment. The company also provides fab support services, including turnkey facilities hook-up and specialty chemicals.
capabilities: Wafer fabrication process equipment for lithography
Board level test equipment for functional test and optical inspection

regional_presence.Singapore: Ellipsiz DSS has a significant presence with offices in Singapore.
regional_presence.Malaysia: The company operates in Malaysia, providing local support to the semiconductor industry.
regional_presence.China: Ellipsiz DSS has established operations in China to cater to the growing semiconductor market.
The company maintains a presence in Taiwan to support semiconductor manufacturing and distribution.
